# Frozen content-4 transition inputs

Captured from commit f6a5769 before the owner's arcade handling/elevation revision.
The four configuration/compatibility files are byte copies. The profile fixture
contains a synthetic valid 0.1-second record/ghost and fresh Cup, plus an actual
600-tick in-progress eight-car source race using the content-4 controller. This is
migration evidence, not an earned race result, lap time or performance claim.

The profile manifest binds every frozen component and ghost by SHA-256. No online
identity was created. Later content versions must preserve these bytes and reject
incompatible continuation rather than reinterpret them under changed handling.
Do not regenerate old fixtures to make a new controller pass. The exact previous
bakes/core source remain available in the cited Git revision and their frozen
compatibility manifest.
